title: Look far away
text: Find something about 6 metres (20 feet) away and rest your eyes on it until the timer ends.

title: Blink slowly
text: We blink less while reading a screen. Close your eyes fully and slowly, ten times.

title: Out the window
text: Look out the nearest window and find the farthest thing you can see.

title: Small breaks count
text: Breaks of under ten minutes lift energy and lower fatigue. Take this one fully.

title: Drop your shoulders
text: Let your shoulders fall, unclench your jaw and breathe out slowly. Twice.

title: Posture check
text: Shift how you are sitting, and check the screen sits just below eye level.
source_title: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety

title: Shoulder rolls
text: Roll your shoulders backwards five times, slowly.

title: Three breaths
text: Close your eyes and take three slow breaths, longer out than in.

title: Open hands
text: Spread your fingers wide, then make a loose fist. Five times.

title: Look over your shoulder
text: Turn your head slowly to look over one shoulder, then the other.

title: Go for a short walk
text: Light walking breaks during long sitting lower blood sugar and insulin after meals. Walk until the timer ends.

title: Water, the long way
text: Refill your glass of water and take the longest route back.

title: Ten slow squats
text: Stand up and do ten slow squats or ten calf raises. Hold the desk if you like.

title: One flight
text: Climb a flight of stairs and come back down.

title: Reach and lean
text: Reach both arms overhead, then lean gently to each side. Hold each for about ten seconds.
source_title: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety

title: Break up sitting
text: Two minutes of light walking every 20 minutes lowered blood sugar and insulin compared with sitting straight through.

title: Step away
text: Leave the screen. Stand at a window, stretch, and let your eyes rest on the distance.

title: Tidy one thing
text: Stand up and put away three things around you.

title: Palm your eyes
text: Cup your palms over your closed eyes to block the light. Breathe slowly.

title: Near, then far
text: Look at something close, then at something 3 metres (10 feet) away. Switch a few times.

title: Widen your view
text: Soften your gaze and notice the edges of the room without moving your eyes.

title: Rest your eyes
text: Close your eyes and let the muscles of your face go soft.

title: Reach for the ceiling
text: Reach both hands toward the ceiling and stretch tall.

title: Side stretch
text: Sitting tall, reach one arm over your head toward the other side. Then switch.

title: Wrist circles
text: Circle your wrists slowly, five times each way.

title: Gentle twist
text: Sitting tall, turn your upper body gently to one side, then the other.

title: Ear to shoulder
text: Tilt your head gently toward one shoulder, then the other. Move slowly.

title: Open your chest
text: Clasp your hands behind your back and gently draw your shoulders back.

title: Soft face
text: Let your jaw hang loose and soften your forehead and the skin around your eyes.

title: Out through a straw
text: Breathe out slowly through pursed lips, as if through a straw.

title: Belly breaths
text: Rest a hand on your belly and feel it rise and fall for three breaths.

title: Even breaths
text: Breathe in for a count of four and out for a count of four. Repeat.

title: One big sigh
text: Take a breath in and let it go with a long, audible sigh.

title: A few sips
text: Have a few sips of water. If the glass is empty, refill it at the next long break.

title: Wiggle your toes
text: Wiggle your toes inside your shoes and notice your feet on the floor.

title: Ankle circles
text: Lift one foot and circle the ankle slowly, then the other.

title: Seated march
text: Sitting tall, lift one knee a little, then the other, like a slow march.

title: Up on your toes
text: Stand, hold the desk, and rise slowly onto your toes five times.

title: Shoulder blades
text: Squeeze your shoulder blades gently together, hold for a breath, release. Three times.

title: Wrist stretch
text: Hold one arm out, palm down, and gently bend the wrist up and down. Switch arms.

title: Shake it out
text: Let your arms hang and shake your hands out loosely.

title: Chin to chest
text: Let your chin drop slowly toward your chest and hold for a breath.

title: Smile, then soften
text: Smile gently, then let your whole face relax.

title: Point and flex
text: Point your toes away, then pull them back toward you. Five times.

title: Stand against a wall
text: Stand with your back against a wall and breathe slowly for a minute. Then walk a little.

title: Arm across
text: Stand, bring one arm across your chest and hold it with the other for a few breaths. Switch.

title: Standing twist
text: Stand with feet apart and turn your upper body slowly from side to side, ten times.

title: Side steps
text: Take ten slow side steps one way, then ten back. Repeat a few times.

title: Arm swings
text: Stand and swing your arms gently across your body and back for a minute.

title: Hip circles
text: Stand with hands on your hips and make slow circles, five each way.

title: Heel to toe
text: Holding the desk, rock slowly onto your toes, then back onto your heels. Ten times.

title: Walk up the wall
text: Face a wall and walk your fingers up it as high as is comfortable. Lower slowly.

title: Notice your breath
text: Stand still, close your eyes, and notice the air moving in and out of your nose.

title: March on the spot
text: March on the spot at an easy pace for a minute, rest, and repeat.

title: Four in, six out
text: Stand tall and breathe in for four, out for six. Ten rounds.

title: Calf stretch
text: Hands on the wall, step one foot back with the heel down and lean in gently. Switch.

title: Morning-style stretch
text: Stretch like you just woke up: arms, legs and back, slowly, any way that feels good.
